title: Henrietta Maria's household (St Germain) to Charles I, September 1645, in Lasry's 'TNA SP 106' key: TNA SP 106/10 ff. 213-215, 230-232, 233-234 (DECODE R785, R790, R923)

steps.what: Fetched the DECODE record pages with the shared cookie; each links Lasry's reconstructed key and plaintext (2020-10-23) for the ff. 207-247 run. R785, R790 and R923 carry his 'TNA SP 106' key and the interlinear file for ff. 207-234.

Re-fetched the record files and applied Lasry's TNA SP 106 key group by group to the transcriptions of R785, R790 and R923 (apply_key.py). The key gives a value to 3069 of 3373 groups; on the lines whose columns line up in his interlinear file (2712 keyed groups) every value equals his plaintext.

Split from the former combined target hm1645 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): R785, R790, R923 (TNA SP 106 key) stay here; R787 (SP106-2), R924 (SP106-8) and R929 (SP106-5) became sp106r787, sp106r924, sp106r929. Folder, profile, page and ledgers separated; earlier steps are kept as recorded.

outcome.method_basis: The three letters were taken from George Lasry's plaintext on the DECODE records (23 Oct 2020); his TNA SP 106 key, applied here to the transcriptions only as a check, reproduces it.
outcome.fraction_read_source: apply_key.py over decode/ (Lasry's interlinear file, Pettersson's groups): 3069 of 3373 cipher groups have a value in Lasry's key (R785 1718/1882, R790 693/769, R923 658/722)

gaps.item: three-digit nomenclator numbers left in brackets in Lasry's plaintext (58 distinct, 99 tokens across the three letters, e.g. 295, 498, 326, 474)
gaps.detail: Mostly names; Lasry left them open. Not reconstructed here (outside this entry's method: his decipherment was taken as it is).

gaps.item: one- and two-digit figures with no value in the key (78, 77, 16, 49, 59, 39, 30, 79 and three rarer ones: 11 distinct, 205 tokens)
gaps.detail: They fall between words; word dividers or nulls, though Lasry's key file says there are no nulls. Not settled here.

outcome.notes: Nothing about the text is new: Lasry's decipherment on DECODE is the reading. The writers sign with numbers (120 in R785 and R923). Siblings in the same key, per Lasry's files: R752, R754, R788 (ff. 218, 220-221).

credits.note: reconstructed key 'TNA SP 106' (Sept 1645) and interlinear plaintext of R785, R790, R923, with dating notes
credits.source: DECODE R785, R790, R923 record files

prior.where: DECODE record files of R785, R790, R923 (George Lasry, 23 Oct 2020: reconstructed key, interlinear plaintext, dating notes)

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
